title: Brown Eyed Girl Sportfishing
specs: No liquor or illegal drugs permitted; intoxication leads to trip cancellation with no refund
Bring sunglasses, sunscreen, foul weather gear if necessary
Wear boat shoes, fishing boots or sneakers; no black soled shoes or boots
blurb: Guests book fishing charters departing from Point Pleasant Beach. The boat uses coolers for fish storage; guests bring their own food unless arranged otherwise. Appropriate dress includes sunglasses, sunscreen, foul weather gear, and boat-appropriate footwear.
extraNote: 25% deposit required to book any trip · If trip cancelled by captain, trip will be rescheduled or deposit refunded · Deposits not used during calendar year may be carried over or refunded with 5% credit card processing fee · Cancellation by charter less than one month before trip forfeits deposit · Liquor, illegal drugs, glass bottles, and firearms are not permitted · If intoxicated after departure, trip cancelled with no refund · Dock at 100 Riverside Place, Point Pleasant Beach, NJ
